sam: Quick one — Node SDK streaming keeps getting 401s when API key loaded from file. curl with header works but our fetch stream fails. any quick ideas?

alex: Do you mean Basic auth header? What does the header look like when it fails vs when it works?

sam: Yeah Basic. I build it like: `const token = Buffer.from(apiKey + ':').toString('base64')` then `Authorization: Basic ${token}`. If I do `curl -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'KEY:' | base64)"` it works, but the app that reads the key from `/run/secrets/` gets 401 on stream.

irene: Likely a trailing newline in the secret file. `cat` usually returns a newline. That changes the base64 payload. Try trimming the key before encoding.

maya: Also mac vs linux base64 wrapping can bite you. On some utilities `base64` wraps lines which breaks headers. Recommend `base64 | tr -d '\n'` or `openssl base64 -A`.

alex: Node-specific: read the file with `fs.readFileSync('/path/to/key','utf8').trim()`; `trim()` fixes 
 on Windows runners and trailing 
. For browser code, `btoa(apiKey + ':')` vs `Buffer` differences matter.

marie: Quick language cheatsheet I use: Python: `open('/path').read().strip()`; Go: `strings.TrimSpace(string(b))`; Rust: `std::str::from_utf8(&bytes)?.trim()` — always trim before `base64`ing.

dev-bot: CI note — added a linter check suggestion: secret files must not contain trailing newline; flag on PR if `cat secret | wc -c` != `echo -n secret | wc -c`.

ops-bot: Logs show `authorization header mismatch` and `expected length 44 got 45` — classic extra newline char.

sam: Confirmed — adding `.trim()` fixed streaming 401s. Thanks! :tada:

alex: Curl example that reproduces the good header: `curl -v -H "Authorization: Basic $(echo -n 'APIKEY:' | base64 | tr -d '\n')" https://api.redwood.example/v1/stream`

irene: Also watch out for Windows CRLF in some CI images (GitHub Actions windows-latest). `dos2unix` or `tr -d '\r'` in pipeline helps.

sam: Will add a tiny unit test that reads the secret and asserts `Buffer.from(key + ':').toString('base64').includes('=')`? maybe too flaky — better assert trimmed length matches expected.

maya: FYI this came up before for grpc streaming too — handshake fails if header != expected bytes.

sam: Great, I'll patch init code and push. Ping me if you want to eyeball the PR. :eyes:
